 Jenna Bush Hager details awkward conversation with son Hal, 7, about her ex-boyfriends 
 By 
 Vanessa Serna 
 Published 
 Nov. 10, 2026, 7:57 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Jenna Bush Hager revealed that her son, Hal, asked about her ex-boyfriends while her husband, Henry Hager, was out of town.
 The journalist recalled watching an unnamed rom-com with the 7-year-old when he inquired about the men she dated before her 2008 wedding.
 “He’s like, ‘Mom, do you like anybody the way that girl likes him?’” she shared on Tuesday’s episode of “Today with Jenna & Sheinelle.” “And I was like, ‘Yes, your father.’”

 Hal then pushed the question a bit further, asking if Bush Hager, 44, “liked other guys before Dad.”
 “I had to go through the old roster,” she joked.
 Bush Hager told viewers she skipped over “all the entry levels” and only mentioned the “higher-level” boyfriends.
 8 
 “He’s like, ‘Mom, do you like anybody the way that girl likes him?’” she told “Today” show viewers on Tuesday. NBC News 
 8 
 “And I was like, ‘Yes, your father,'” Bush Hager added, referring to her husband, Henry Hager. jennabhager/Instagram 
 “At some point I was like, what am I doing? Why am I doing this?” she quipped.
 Hal then asked his mom why she liked her exes, to which she responded, “I don’t even remember, Hal! It was 25 years ago!”
 Bush Hager admitted she continued to entertain the conversation, explaining to her son the fun of dating.

 “I wanted to get people dating again! What are y’all doing if you’re not dating?” she said. “Love and be loved!”
 The daytime reporter shares Hal, along with daughters Poppy, 11, and Mila, 13, with Henry. The couple tied the knot in May 2008 at her Texas family ranch.
 Bush Hager has never shied away from talking about her former relationships and previously admitted she “didn’t date enough” before getting married during a 2024 episode of her morning show.
 8 
 Bush Hager admitted she continued to entertain the conversation. jennabhager/Instagram 
 8 
 Bush Hager shares three kids with her husband. (Seen here: The family of five.) jennabhager/Instagram 
 “I dated in college. I dated in high school. I didn’t date enough,” she told former co-host Hoda Kotb, who retired in January 2025. 
  “You don’t have to stay in a relationship if you are not engaged in it,” Bush Hager continued. “I was a serial monogamist, which was fine, but I should have dated more.”
 The news anchor clarified that she and Henry had “built a really incredible life” that she is proud of, but advised women “should have fun and date” while they can.
